title: Grateful Dead Live at Cal Expo Amphitheatre on 1989-08-06
lineage: Cassette Master Transferred:  Sony TC-D5M > HHb CDR 800 PRO Via Analog i/o > CD Masters > FLAC
source: Source:  Nakamichi CM-300 CP-4 Shotgun Capsules > Sony WM-D6C (XLIIS)

ai_review.summary: A stellar Cal Expo show captured on a quirky shotgun‑mic audience tape.
ai_review.review: The reviewer hails the concert as the peak of the tour, praising the venue vibe and the band's performance despite a lone weak Brent Mydland song. The recording is described as “weird” due to shotgun microphones, giving it an off‑kilter but listenable sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is rated extremely high (peak performance), but the recording quality is noted as odd, pulling the overall rating down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Shotgun microphones used for audience capture result in a strange, uneven sound; not clear but still intelligible.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy set with excellent vibes throughout; the only dip noted is Brent's song which felt out of place.

band_member_comments.Keys: Negative comment on Brent Mydland's "I will bum you out" as one of the worst songs.
